en: %1,<n>I am glad that you have come. Come in and I'll see if I have something for you.
zh: %1 ，<n>很高兴你来了。 进来吧， 我看看有没有事给你做。
ja: %1,<n>来てくれて嬉しい。 入りなさい、 あなたに 合うものが あるか見てみましょう。
asr_text: It's good to see you here. Come in and I'll see if I have something for you.

en: %1,<n>in normal circumstances I wouldn't see you now, but times are hard and I have something to discuss with you.
zh: %1,<n>换作平时我不会在这个时候见你,但眼下时局艰难,我有些事要跟你谈。
ja: %1,<n>普通なら今あなたには会いませんが、 時世が 厳しいので話したいことが あります。
asr_text: In normal circumstances I wouldn't see you now, but times are hard and I have something to discuss with you.

en: %1,<n>you know quite well I'd tell you to go to hell under normal circumstances, but in dire times like these, I'd sell my soul to the devil himself.<n><n>So come on in, I have something to tell you.
zh: %1 ，<n>换作平时， 我早叫你见鬼去了， 但眼下这种危难时候， 我连灵魂都肯卖给魔鬼本人。<n><n>那就进来吧， 我有件事要告诉你。
ja: %1,<n>普段なら地獄へ 行けと言うところですが、 こんな非常時には、 悪魔にだって魂を 売りますよ。<n><n>さあ入ってください、 話したいことが あります。
asr_text: You know quite well I tell you to go to hell under normal circumstances. But in dire times like these I'd sell my souls that devil himself. So come on in I have something to tell you.

en: %1,<n>thank you for capturing one of our enemy's towns.
zh: %1 ，<n>谢谢你替我们攻下了一座敌方城镇。
ja: %1,<n>敵の町を 1 つ占領してくれて感謝します。
asr_text: Thank you for capturing one of our enemies' towns.

en: %1,<n>I have already given you a mission. Accomplish this mission, as I have more for you to do.
zh: %1 ，<n>我已经给你一件委托了。 把它完成吧， 我还有更多事要交给你。
ja: %1,<n>すでに任務を 与えています。 それを 果たしてください。 他にも任せたいことが あります。
asr_text: I have already given you a mission. Accomplish this mission as I have more for you to do.

en: %1,<n>your mission was to capture a town, but you have failed. I hope you will stick to our agreements next time.
zh: %1 ，<n>你的委托是攻占一座城镇， 但你失败了。 希望下次你还记得我们的约定。
ja: %1,<n>あなたの任務は 町の占領でしたが、 果たせませんでした。 次は 約束を 守ってほしいものです。
asr_text: Your mission was to capture a town, but you have failed. I hope you will stick to our agreements next time.

en: You have wreaked much destruction upon my nation, but you are also the only man who can save our fate. I will offer you our friendship for %1. What do you say?
zh: 你给我国造成了巨大的破坏， 但同时你也是唯一能挽救我国命运的人。 我愿意用 %1 换取与我国的友谊。 你意下如何？
ja: あなたは わが国に 大きな損害を 与えてきましたが、 我々の運命を 救える唯一の人物でもあります。 %1 と引き換えに、 我々の友情を 差し出しましょう。 どうしますか？
asr_text: You have wreaked much destruction upon my nation. But you are also the only man who can save our fate. I will offer you our friendship. What do you say?

en: I'm delighted! From this day onwards, the hostilities between us are a thing of the past.
zh: 太好了！ 从今天起， 我们之间的敌意一笔勾销。
ja: 嬉しく思います！ 今日から 我々の敵意は 過去のものに なりました。
asr_text: I'm delighted. From this day onwards, the hostilities between us are a thing of the past.

en: My nation recently lost the last governor town to its enemies.<n><n>If these enemy nations are weakened by having their military convoys sunk, we will then be able to win back some towns.<n><n>To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will  issue you with a Letter of Marque against our enemies.
zh: 我国最近把最后一座总督城镇丢给了敌人。<n><n>只要击沉这些敌国的军事船队、 削弱他们， 我们就能夺回一些城镇。<n><n>为免和其他国家起冲突， 我给你签发一份针对敌人的私掠许可证。
ja: わが国は 先ごろ、 最後の総督都市を 敵に 奪われました。<n><n>敵国の軍事船団を 沈めて弱らせれば、 いくつかの町を 取り戻せます。<n><n>他国との摩擦を 避けるため、 敵に対する 私掠免許状を 発行しましょう。
asr_text: My nation has recently lost its last Governor town to its enemies. If these enemy nations are weakened by having their military convoy sunk, we will then be able to win back some towns. To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a letter of mark against our enemies.

en: You have served my nation long and faithfully, now I must reward you for your loyalty. I shall give you a parcel of land on which you can establish your own town.
zh: 你长久以来忠心事奉我的国家， 如今我必须奖赏你的忠诚。 我赐你一块土地， 你可以据此建立自己的城镇。
ja: 長く忠実に わが国に 仕えてくれました。 その忠誠に 報いねばなりません。 自分の町を 築ける土地の一区画を 与えましょう。
asr_text: You have served my nation long and faithfully. Now I must reward you for your loyalty. I shall give you a parcel of land on which you can establish your own town.

en: Let %1 be your new town. You can now enter it just like any other town to erect buildings and set up businesses there.<n>The entire district is not yet available to you, but, if you capture additional towns, I will give you the land you need for this.
zh: 就让 %1 成为你的新城吧。 现在你就能像进出其他城镇一样进出它， 在那里建起建筑、 开办产业。<n>整片辖区暂时还不能归你使用， 但若你攻占更多城镇， 我会把所需的土地交给你。
ja: %1 をあなたの新しい町に しましょう。 これで 他の町と 同じように 入って、 建物を 建て事業を 興せます。<n>地区全体は まだ使えませんが、 さらに町を 占領すれば、 そのための土地を 与えます。
asr_text: Let this be your new town. You can now enter it just like any other town to erect buildings and set up businesses there. The entire district is not yet available to you, but if you capture additional towns, I will give you the land you need for this.

en: I must thank you once again, you have done so much for my nation. I shall reward you with additional land for your town %1. You will then own %2% of the district.
zh: 我必须再次感谢你， 你为我国做了这么多。 作为奖赏， 我会为你的城镇 %1 追加土地。 届时你将拥有该地区 %2% 的土地。
ja: あらためて感謝します。 あなたは わが国のために 多くのことを してくれました。 褒美として、 あなたの町 %1 に土地を 追加で 与えましょう。 これで この地区の総面積の %2% を 所有することに なります。
asr_text: I must thank you once again. You have done so much for my nation. I shall reward you with additional land for your town. You now own a larger part of the district.

en: I must thank you once again, you have done so much for my nation. As a reward, I shall give you the remaining land for your town %1. You now own the entire district.
zh: 我必须再次感谢你， 你为我国做了这么多。 作为奖赏， 我把城镇 %1 剩下的土地也给你。 现在你拥有整个区域了。
ja: あらためて感謝します。 あなたは わが国のために 多くのことを してくれました。 褒美として、 あなたの町 %1 に残りの土地を 追加で 与えましょう。 これで 地区全体を 所有することに なります。
asr_text: I must thank you once again. You have done so much for my nation. I shall reward you with the remaining land for your town. You now own the entire district.

en: We are at war with %1, but the enemy does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters. I want you to take advantage of this and capture a town.
zh: 我们正与 %1 交战， 但敌人的军事船队不足以守卫它的海域。 我要你抓住这个机会， 攻占一座城镇。
ja: 我々は %1 と戦争中ですが、 敵は 自国の海域を 守るだけの軍事船団を 持っていません。 この機を 活かして町を 1 つ占領してください。
asr_text: We are at war. But the enemy does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters. I want you to take advantage of this and capture a town.

en: I am therefore assigning you the mission of capturing a colonial town belonging to %2 by %1.    The town must not be the seat of a governor or the viceroy!
zh: 所以我派你执行这项任务： 在 %1 之前攻占一座属于 %2 的殖民地城镇。 这座城镇不能是总督或总督府所在地！
ja: %1 までに %2 の植民地の町を 1 つ占領する任務を 命じます。 ただし総督や 総督代理の所在地であってはなりません！
asr_text: I am therefore assigning you the mission of capturing a colonial town. The town must not be the seat of a governor or the vice-roy.

en: I am therefore assigning you the mission of capturing a colonial town belonging to %2 by %1.    The town must not be the seat of a governor or the viceroy!<n><n>To avoid problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a Letter of Marque against %2.
zh: 所以我派你执行这项任务： 在 %1 之前攻占一座属于 %2 的殖民地城镇。 这座城镇不能是总督或总督府所在地！<n><n>为免和其他国家起纠纷， 我会给你一张针对 %2 的私掠许可证。
ja: %1 までに %2 の植民地の町を 1 つ占領する任務を 命じます。 ただし総督や 総督代理の所在地であってはなりません！<n><n>他国との摩擦を 避けるため、 %2 に対する私掠免許状を 発行しましょう。
asr_text: I am therefore assigning you the mission of capturing a colonial town. The town must not be the seat of a governor or the viceroy. To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a letter of mark against our enemies.

en: %1 does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters! We should get going this instant and capture a town!!<n>Can I rely on you?
zh: %1 的军事船队不足以守卫它的海域！ 那就立刻出发， 攻占一座城镇！！<n>我能指望你吗？
ja: %1 は自国の海域を 守るだけの軍事船団を 持っていません！ 今すぐ動いて町を 1 つ占領しましょう！！<n>任せられますか？
asr_text: Our enemy does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters. We should get going this instant and capture a town. Can I rely on you?

en: So be it.<n>Your mission is to capture any town belonging to  %2 by %1.
zh: 就这么定了。<n>你的任务是在 %1 之前攻占任意一座属于 %2 的城镇。
ja: よろしい。<n>あなたの任務は %1 までに %2 の町を 1 つ占領することです。
asr_text: So be it. Your mission is to capture a town belonging to our enemy.

en: Your mission is to capture any town belonging to %2 by %1.<n>To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a Letter of Marque against %2.
zh: 你的任务是在 %1 之前攻占任意一座属于 %2 的城镇。<n>为免和其他国家起纠纷， 我会给你一张针对 %2 的私掠许可证。
ja: あなたの任務は %1 までに %2 の町を 1 つ占領することです。<n>他国との摩擦を 避けるため、 %2 に対する私掠免許状を 発行しましょう。
asr_text: Your mission is to capture any town belonging to our enemy. To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will issue you with a letter of mark against our enemies.

en: Look here. I have just received a message from my ambassador informing me that %1 has made us a unexpected peace offering. This means that we will probably make peace as early as today. <n><n>Therefore, I can no longer assign you a mission to capture a town.
zh: 听着。 我刚收到大使的来信， 说 %1 向我们递上了和谈的橄榄枝。 这意味着我们今天就有可能议和。<n><n>所以， 我不能再派你攻打城镇的任务了。
ja: 聞いてください。 大使から、 %1 が思いがけない和平の申し出を してきたと連絡が ありました。 つまり今日にも和平が 成立するでしょう。<n><n>ですから、 もう町を 占領する任務は 任せられません。
asr_text: Look here. I have just received a message from my ambassador informing me that our enemy has made us an unexpected peace offering. This means that we will probably make peace as early as today. Therefore, I can no longer assign you a mission to capture a town.

en: I would like to thank you once again for being so generous as to hand over one of your convoys. It is currently being armed and will be ready to set sail in %1 days.<n><n>If you want to hand over another convoy, you must wait until then.
zh: 我要再次感谢你如此慷慨地交出一支船队。 它正在装配， 预计 %1 天后就能出海。<n><n>如果你还想再交出一支船队， 就得等到那以后。
ja: 船団を 一隻譲ってくれる寛大さに、 あらためて感謝します。 現在武装中で、 %1 日後に 出航できる予定です。<n><n>もう一隻引き渡したいなら、 それまで 待ってください。
asr_text: I would like to thank you once again for being so generous as to hand over one of your convoys. It is currently being armed and will soon be ready to set sail. If you want to hand over another convoi, you must wait until then.

en: We are not at war with any other nation, but we cannot safely increase our military strength with additional convoys. <n><n>Could you let me have one of your own convoys?
zh: 我们没有与任何国家交战,但也无法安全地靠扩充船队来增强军力。<n><n>你能把你的一支船队借给我吗?
ja: どの国とも 戦争中ではありませんが、 船団を 増やして軍事力を 安全に 高めることは できません。<n><n>あなたの船団を 一隻譲ってもらえませんか？
asr_text: We are not at war with any other nation, but we could increase our military strength with additional convoys as a precaution. Could you let me have one of your own convoys? Could you let me have one of your own convoys?

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1, but, unfortunately, %1 still has too many military convoys and is therefore not weak enough.<n><n> In any case, I do not have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured areas.<n><n>Could you let me have one of your own convoys?
zh: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇,可惜 %1 还有太多军事船队,并不算薄弱。<n><n>况且我也没有足够的军事船队去防守新占下的地盘。<n><n>你能把你的一支船队借给我吗?
ja: %1 の町を 占領する任務を 喜んで任せたいところですが、 あいにく %1 はまだ軍事船団が 多すぎて、 弱体化が 十分ではありません。<n><n>いずれに せよ、 新たに 占領した地域を 守るだけの軍事船団が 私には足りません。<n><n>あなたの船団を 一隻譲ってもらえませんか？
asr_text: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to our enemies, but unfortunately, they still have too many military convoys and are therefore not weak enough. In any case, I do not have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured areas. Could you let me have one of your own convoys?

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1, but, unfortunately, I do not have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>Could you let me have one of your own convoys?
zh: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇,可惜我没有足够的军事船队去防守新占下的地盘。<n><n>你能把你的一支船队借给我吗?
ja: %1 の町を 占領する任務を 喜んで任せたいところですが、 あいにく新たに 占領した地域を 守るだけの軍事船団が 私には足りません。<n><n>あなたの船団を 一隻譲ってもらえませんか？
asr_text: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to our enemies. But I do not have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured areas. Could you let me have one of your own convoys?

en: Unfortunately you have no suitable convoys left anchored in the harbor. The convoy must consist of exactly 5 ships and have 150 cannons on board. Come back when you have assembled such a convoy.
zh: 可惜港口里没有符合要求的船队了。 船队必须正好由 5 条船组成， 且船上共带 150 门炮。 等你凑齐这样的船队再来。
ja: あいにく港に 適した船団が 停泊していません。 船団は ちょうど 5 隻で、 大砲を 150 門積んでいる必要が あります。 そのような船団を 編成してから来てください。
asr_text: Unfortunately, you have no suitable convoy's left anchored in the harbor. The convoy must consist of exactly five ships and have 150 cannons on board. Come back when you have assembled such a convoy.

en: Which convoy can you offer me?
zh: 你能给我提供哪支船队？
ja: どの船団を 提供できますか？
asr_text: Which convoy can you offer me?

en: I thank you on behalf of my nation. The convoy will now be licked into shape and the crew will be assembled. It will be ready to set sail in 15 days.<n><n>If you want to hand over another convoy, you must wait until then.
zh: 我谨代表我国向你致谢。 这支船队会整编完毕， 船员也会招募齐备， 15 天后即可启航。<n><n>若想再交给我一支船队， 得等到那时候。
ja: わが国を 代表して感謝します。 船団は これから整備され、 乗員も 集められます。 出航できるのは 15 日後です。<n><n>別の船団を 引き渡したいなら、 それまで 待ってください。
asr_text: I thank you on behalf of my nation. The convoy will now be licked into shape and the crew will be assembled. In 15 days it will be ready to set sail. If you want to hand over another convoy, you must wait until then.

en: I cannot task you with capturing a town belonging to another nation on my behalf because we are not at war at the present time. However, things may change very quickly. Come back to me if they do.
zh: 眼下我们并未开战， 所以我不能派你替我去攻占别国的城镇。 不过情况也许很快就会变化。 真有变化再来找我。
ja: 今は 戦争中ではないので、 他国の町を 占領する任務は 任せられません。 しかし状況は すぐ変わりえます。 変わったらまた来てください。
asr_text: I cannot task you with capturing a town belonging to another nation on my behalf because we are not at war at the present time. However, things may change very quickly. Come back to me if they do.

en: We are at war with %1 and you have ensured that %1 only has one town left. We cannot take this, and so I am unable to task you with capturing any town at present. <n><n>But do come back again when the situation changes.
zh: 我们正与 %1 交战， 而你已让 %1 只剩下一座城镇。 这我们无法接受， 所以眼下我不能派你攻占任何城镇。<n><n>不过情况一变， 还请再来。
ja: 我々は %1 と戦争中で、 あなたが %1 を町一つにまで追い込みました。 これ以上の占領は 許されず、 今は 町を 占領する任務を 任せられません。<n><n>状況が 変わったらまた来てください。
asr_text: We are at war, and you have ensured that our enemy has only one town left. We cannot take this, and so I am unable to task you with capturing any town at present. But do come back again when the situation changes.

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1.  I have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>However, %1 is still too strong for such an undertaking.<n><n>You could help to weaken %1 by destroying its military convoys.<n><n>Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.
zh: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇。 我手头的军事船队足够守住任何新占下的地盘。<n><n>不过 %1 目前对这项任务来说还是太强了。<n><n>你可以摧毁 %1 的军事船队， 助我削弱他们。<n><n>然后再来找我， 也许就有新任务给你。
ja: %1 の町を 占領する任務を 喜んで任せたいところです。 新たに 占領した地域を 守る軍事船団は 十分に あります。<n><n>しかし %1 はまだそうするには強すぎます。<n><n>%1 の軍事船団を 撃破して弱らせてください。<n><n>そうしたら私のところへ 戻ってください。 任務が あるかもしれません。
asr_text: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to our enemies. I have enough military convoys to protect the newly captured area. However, the enemy is still too strong for such an undertaking. You could help to weaken the enemy by destroying its military convoys. Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.

en: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1.  I have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>However, %1 is still too strong for such an undertaking.<n><n>You could help to weaken %1 by destroying its military convoys.<n><n>Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.<n><n><n>You can check a nation’s strength under “Nations” in the Chronicle.
zh: 我很愿意派你去攻占 %1 的一座城镇。 我手头的军事船队足够守住任何新占下的地盘。<n><n>不过 %1 目前对这项任务来说还是太强了。<n><n>你可以摧毁 %1 的军事船队， 助我削弱他们。<n><n>然后再来找我， 也许就有新任务给你。<n><n><n>你可以在 「编年史」 的 「国家」 一栏里查看某国的实力。
ja: %1 の町を 占領する任務を 喜んで任せたいところです。 新たに 占領した地域を 守る軍事船団は 十分に あります。<n><n>しかし %1 はまだ強すぎます。<n><n>%1 の軍事船団を 撃破して弱らせてください。<n><n>そうしたら戻ってきてください。 任務が あるかもしれません。<n><n><n>国の強さは 年代記の 「国家」 で確認できます。
asr_text: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to our enemies. I have enough military convoys to protect the newly captured area. However, the enemy is still too strong for such an undertaking. You could help to weaken the enemy by destroying its military convoys. You can check a nation's strength under nations in the Chronicle. Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.

en: I have no other news for you. See me again when you've accomplished the mission I set you.

asr_text: Welcome! You begin your career in the English town in the year 1600. Your convoy is in the port with an unarmed brig, and your cash assets amount to the value displayed. Good luck!
